name: Germany

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 83577140 inhabitants, recorded as 83.577 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Read on 2026-07-27 from the Werkstatistik 2024/25 of the Deutscher Bühnenverein, its 78th annual edition, freely downloadable. Genre Puppen-/Figurentheater, summary diagrams on pages 388 and 389: for Germany alone, 3 154 Aufführungen, 353 160 Besuche and 286 Inszenierungen, which is 4 per cent of German performances and 2 per cent of German visits. The year is the 2024/25 season, not a calendar year, and is recorded as 2025. Basis 'form': the Werkstatistik classes each production by genre across every reporting theatre, so this is puppetry wherever it was staged. Disputed on coverage, and the gap is large enough that the figure should never be quoted as German puppetry. The Werkstatistik counts the 441 professional theatres of Germany, Austria and Switzerland that report to the Bühnenverein — essentially the publicly funded houses and the larger private ones. Germany's independent Figurentheater scene, which is where most of the country's puppetry is made, reports to nobody and is absent. What this measures is the institutional segment. Two things worth carrying forward from the same tables. The country split is published, which is rare: the D-A-CH total is 3 178 Aufführungen against Germany's 3 154, so Austria and Switzerland together contribute 24 puppet performances among reporting theatres — a fact about who files returns rather than about Austrian puppetry. And the publication's own diagrams disagree slightly with themselves, page 341 giving 352 850 and 353 160 visits and 285 and 286 productions in two adjacent charts. The genre summary figure is the one recorded.

observations.by_venue_covers: Fifty-one producers named, summing to 344 productions. Three mismatches with the headline, all of them structural. The unit differs: these are Inszenierungen, the headline is 3 154 Aufführungen, so no sum check is possible and none should be attempted. The scope differs: this list is the Werkstatistik's whole D-A-CH set and includes Austrian and Swiss entries such as Graz, while the headline is Germany alone. And no entry carries a 'venue' because Germany has no venues_list yet. The list is recorded now because it is the evidence base the German venues pass will start from, and reading it twice would be waste. An earlier note in this file said 66 distinct venues; that was an artefact of the premiere marker (U) splitting entries in the extraction. The figure is 51.

Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. Two establishments retained, both read at source. First, the Ernst Busch drama school in Berlin, puppetry department, a four-year course awarding a diploma in puppetry and performing arts, founded in 1971-72. Second, the state academy of music and performing arts in Stuttgart, whose figure theatre programme was created in 1983 and is awarded at bachelor level only, in an institution explicitly state-run and funded by Baden-Wurttemberg. The German source states Stuttgart is the only conservatoire in the country offering figure theatre, which does not contradict Berlin, a drama school rather than a music school: both count. Upper bound held at 2: both courses are documented and no third appears, training in Germany being otherwise largely carried by private bodies outside the denominator. Re-examined on 2026-07-27 after the ownership ruling, which withdrew private status as a ground for exclusion. The value does not move, but the third entry had to be re-argued rather than left standing on a motive that no longer exists. The Figurentheater-Kolleg in Bochum was re-read at source. Its own site presents an Ausbildungsgang, a training course in the fundamentals of figure theatre, and names no qualification: no Hochschulabschluss, no staatlich anerkannter Abschluss, no diploma or certificate specified anywhere on the page. It sits outside state higher education, and what excludes it is that absence of a state-recognised award, not the fact that it is private. The exclusion reason moves from private to not_degree_granting. The upper bound stays at 2 for the same reason as before, but the phrase carried in the earlier reasoning, that German training is otherwise largely carried by private bodies outside the denominator, no longer holds as written: private bodies are no longer outside by construction. They are outside when they award nothing the State recognises, which is what was checked here and would have to be checked one by one elsewhere.

establishments.description: The puppetry department of the Ernst Busch drama school, founded 1971-72 in East Berlin and still the reference training in the German-speaking world. Moved to the Zinnowitzer Straße campus in 2018.

establishments.description: The figure theatre programme was created in 1983 and remains the only one of its kind at a German conservatoire. The school is state-run, funded by the state of Baden-Württemberg.

establishments.name: Figurentheater-Kolleg
establishments.award: Ausbildungsgang in the fundamentals of figure theatre; no state-recognised qualification named at source
establishments.description: A long-established private college for puppet, material and object theatre. Its site presents an Ausbildungsgang and names no qualification, which is why it is excluded: since the ruling of 2026-07-27 private ownership is no ground, the absence of a state-recognised award is. Recorded here also because it is often mistaken for a state school, including by search engines answering queries about Austria.

venues: not attempted as a value on 2026-07-27, and the reason is scale rather than absence. The Werkstatistik 2024/25 lists every production by genre with the theatre that staged it, and its Puppen-/Figurentheater section names 51 distinct venues across Germany, Austria and Switzerland for 344 productions, now recorded in the by_venue list of the performances observation. That is an auditable starting set, already read. What it does not give is which of the 66 have public backing and which maintain a permanent puppet unit, and under the ruling of 2026-07-27 both questions have to be answered one venue at a time. The volumes point at where to start: Puppentheater der Stadt Magdeburg 34 productions, Theater Waidspeicher Erfurt 22, Staatstheater Meiningen 22, Theater Altenburg Gera 17, Augsburger Puppenkiste 17, tjg. Dresden 15, Theater Halle 11, Städtische Theater Chemnitz 10, Hänneschen Theater der Stadt Köln. Several of those are municipal Sparten rather than freestanding houses and are exactly what the ruling was written for. Germany needs a session of its own.
